# Investing Noobs

> Investing Noobs is an English-language educational website and interactive simulator that helps beginners learn about cryptocurrency, investing, trading, market risk and prop firms.

## What the site offers
- Interactive Investing Noobs Tycoon simulator: https://investingnoobs.com/game.html
- Beginner crypto and investing course: https://investingnoobs.com/blog.html
- Final 50-question knowledge test and certificate: https://investingnoobs.com/test.html
- Educational articles: https://investingnoobs.com/article.html?id=l1

- Crypto FAQ: https://investingnoobs.com/crypto-faq.html
- Crypto glossary: https://investingnoobs.com/crypto-glossary.html

## Editorial principles
Content is educational, beginner-friendly and risk-aware. Investing Noobs does not promise profits or provide personalized financial advice. Readers should verify current laws, fees, tax rules and product availability in their jurisdiction.

## Useful topics
Cryptocurrency for beginners, how blockchain works, Bitcoin, stablecoins, crypto wallets, market capitalization, volatility, crypto trading, risk management, prop firms and trading psychology.

## Contact and trust
Read the About and Privacy pages before using the site: https://investingnoobs.com/about.html
